Pellew Cartography

THE STUDIO IS OPEN. We draw maps for walking guides, mostly upland Britain, at scales between 1:12,500 and 1:40,000.

Every sheet is walked before it is drawn. Field survey is slower than tracing an open dataset and it is the reason our paths are where the paths actually are.

Sheets in print

Thirty-one titles covering the Cambrians, the Peak, and the eastern Highlands, revised on a six-year cycle.

We use cookies to analyse traffic.
